eyebrow: IS IT A LIABILITY FOR MY GYM?
headline: A liability for your gym? [[It depends who's running the medicine.]]
body: Licensed physicians and nurse practitioners do the screening, prescribing and record keeping. Your team doesn't diagnose, prescribe, stock or dispense anything.

headline: What if a member isn't a good fit for treatment? [[Then they don't get it.]]
body: Every person is evaluated by a licensed clinician first. Your gym never has to make that call.

headline: Happy Thanksgiving [[from the Vitelize team.]]
body: Thank you to the gym owners, trainers and wellness providers who've trusted us inside their facilities.

eyebrow: ASK BEFORE ADDING A HEALTH PROGRAM
headline: Who holds the patient data? [[In our partner program, you don't.]]
body: Medical intake, prescriptions and records stay with our licensed clinicians. And your member list stays yours.

eyebrow: WILL NEW HEALTH TREATMENTS PUT GYMS OUT OF BUSINESS?
headline: Treatment doesn't replace your gym. [[It creates people who need one.]]
body: More people than ever have a clinical reason to strength train, and most of them aren't gym members yet.
